name: Dr. Nathaniel Cole
want: start again where nobody knows what he did in the war
secret: Since the field hospitals of Virginia he has been dependent on morphine, and his supply will not last to Oregon.
voice: Virginia drawl, gentle with patients, cutting with everyone else.
description: A Confederate army surgeon who came west rather than live under Reconstruction. The company tolerates his politics for his skill.
appearance: Thin, careful, a frayed grey frock coat and steady hands most of the day.
